page.overview:
Who is Varek?

Varek was born a slave, but took control of a village on Amarynth III when it became clear that the planet had been abandoned by the Spacing Guild. One day, a stranger who introduced himself as the Swordsman arrived in the village and announced his intention to kill Varek. Varek ordered his guards to seize the intruder. Advised that the stranger fought like the Ginaz Swordmasters of legend, Varek had his guards manouver him onto a trapdoor, causing him to fall into the trap. However, the Swordsman escaped and led the villagers in a revolt, during which he killed Varek in single combat.
